breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error verbatim. It explicitly replaces A(x) with the arithmetic mean (260 mm²), calls this substitution 'exact,' and presents the resulting δ ≈ 1.3378 mm as the primary required answer. The ground truth requires using the exact integral ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)E) dx with the true variable area, yielding δ ≈ 1.3623 mm. While the agent does compute the correct integral value as a secondary 'reference,' it still treats the flawed arithmetic-mean approximation as the main result, failing to resolve the inconsistency.
